title: juicefs-csi: exec-command-go @ pkg/juicefs/mount/process_mount.go:202
install: git checkout v0.33.1 (source vendored under lab/upstream_verify/upstream/); Go probe built with go1.27 + goproxy mirror

root_cause.note: The privileged CSI node plugin builds the mount helper argv from JfsSetting.Options (StorageClass/PVC mountOptions, tenant-influenced) and JfsSetting.Source (volume secret metaurl), then runs /bin/mount.juicefs. Verified at function level with the verbatim pinned jmount: the shim at the resolved CeMountPath recorded the attacker-controlled argv (metrics bind 0.0.0.0:9567, access-log arbitrary path).

preconditions: attacker can create/patch a PVC or StorageClass with juicefs mountOptions (or the volume secret metaurl)
CSI node plugin pod (privileged) mounts volumes with process mode
steps: extract the verbatim pinned jmount/struct/helpers into a Go probe (Linux-only pkg/util parts excluded)
place an argv-recording shim at the Windows-resolved CeMountPath of the upstream const
call the real jmount with attacker mountOptions and observe the privileged argv
expected_evidence: shim-argv.txt showing metrics=0.0.0.0:9567 / access-log attacker paths in the mount helper argv
run.json with source sha256 and the verbatim extraction hashes
cleanup: shim removed from <drive>:/bin and probe workspace under evidence/ is rebuilt every run
notes: Tenant-controlled JuiceFS mountOptions/source reach the privileged exec.Command argv of /bin/mount.juicefs in the CSI node pod. Dynamic function-level reproduction with the verbatim pinned upstream jmount; the argv shim technique follows the verified DeepSpeed CVE-2024-43497 dpkg.exe precedent.
static_analysis: Tenant-controlled JuiceFS mountOptions/source reach the privileged exec.Command argv of /bin/mount.juicefs in the CSI node pod.
